Double-entry journals for disbursements, instalments due (interest, fees, credit-life premiums), default charges, receipts, reversals, refunds, waivers and write-offs, one month at a time. Each money event is exported once; a closed month never changes.

Before the first close

The go-live month (history before it posts as one opening entry), VAT, and your confirmation of the chart of accounts below.

MAPPING NOT CONFIRMED
Go-live month
Save go-live month
VAT-registered: yes, 15%
Turn VAT split off

VAT is split only from fee accounts marked VAT-inclusive in the mapping. Credit notes on lease invoices, on an instalment sale's or finance lease's inception invoice and on a repossession sale are exported; a credit note on any other instalment-sale or finance-lease invoice is not yet, and holds the month open.

No month closes until an administrator reviews the chart of accounts below and confirms it. Any later change to it needs confirming again.

Asset-finance accounts:
0 OF 16 CONFIRMED

Not yet confirmed: Instalment sale and finance lease debtors, Lease debtors, VAT input, Assets under operating lease, Lease asset disposal proceeds, Rental income, Maintenance income, Maintenance fund liability, Maintenance claims paid, Recovery clearing, Recovery costs payable, Recovery costs, Recovery costs recharged, Recovery surplus refunds payable, Recovery result, Asset-finance price credits. A month that posts one of these closes only after the mapping is confirmed again.

I have reviewed the mapping: confirm it

A SAST calendar month. Months close in order from the go-live month, once ended; closing seals its journals for good.

Chart of accounts

Where each journal line posts in your general ledger. Xero refuses manual journals to a bank account: map Bank to a clearing account.

Save mapping
JOURNAL ROLE	ACCOUNT CODE	ACCOUNT NAME	TAX CODE	VAT-INCL.


bank

Cash paid out and received. In Xero map this to a clearing account: manual journals cannot post to a bank account

	
	
	
	


payout clearing

Loans booked whose payout the provider has not yet confirmed paid (payout channel on)

	
	
	
	


loan book

Everything borrowers owe: principal plus interest, fees, premiums and charges once due

	
	
	
	


unallocated receipts

Money received and not yet applied to a loan, or owed back as a refund

	
	
	
	


credit life payable

Bundled credit-life premiums owed to the insurer as they fall due; uncollected premium is reversed on write-off

	
	
	
	


output vat

VAT inside VAT-inclusive fees, when the lender is VAT-registered

	
	
	
	


opening balance equity

Contra of the go-live opening entry; reconcile it to the legacy ledger

	
	
	
	


interest income

Contractual interest as instalments fall due

	
	
	
	


fee income

Initiation and monthly service fees

	
	
	
	


default interest income

Default interest charged after a missed instalment

	
	
	
	


default fee income

Post-default service fees, letter and collection fees

	
	
	
	


bad debt recovery

Money received on a written-off loan

	
	
	
	


bad debt expense

Loan balances written off

	
	
	
	


waiver expense

Sub-R1 residues closed by a waiver

	
	
	
	


Asset finance

Instalment sales, leases and repossessions. Their VAT posts on its own lines, so these accounts take no tax code. Confirm the mapping again before the first month that posts them.




af instalment debtors

Asset finance: the financed amount plus interest as it falls due, less receipts

	
	
	
	


lease debtors

Asset finance: rentals and end-of-term invoices once invoiced, less receipts

	
	
	
	


input vat

Asset finance: VAT on the dealer's invoice, on recovery costs and on repossession (s8(10))

	
	
	
	


leased assets

Cost excluding VAT of leased assets; depreciation stays in the fixed-asset register

	
	
	
	


asset disposal proceeds

Price excluding VAT of an asset sold to its lessee; derecognise its book value in the fixed-asset register

	
	
	
	


rental income

Lease rentals and end-of-term charges excluding VAT, as invoiced

	
	
	
	


maintenance income

Maintenance portion of full-maintenance lease rentals excluding VAT

	
	
	
	


maintenance fund liability

Lessee-settled maintenance funds: contributions less claims and refunds

	
	
	
	


maintenance expense

Maintenance claims paid on lender-risk leases

	
	
	
	


recovery clearing

Repossession sales and costs, per recovery; clears to nil once the proceeds are applied or the recovery is withdrawn

	
	
	
	


recovery costs payable

Supplier invoices for recovery costs, settled through accounts payable

	
	
	
	


recovery cost expense

Recovery costs charged to the borrower's account, excluding VAT

	
	
	
	


recovery costs recharged

Contra-expense: recovery costs charged to the borrower's account

	
	
	
	


recovery refund payable

Surplus owed back to the debtor after a recovery sale

	
	
	
	


recovery result

Gain or loss left in recovery clearing: output VAT less repossession and cost input VAT

	
	
	
	


af price credits

Price excluding VAT credited to an instalment-sale or finance-lease debtor on the inception invoice; book the dealer's matching credit, if any, against it

Instalment sales, leases and repossessions. Their VAT posts on its own lines, so these accounts take no tax code. Confirm the mapping again before the first month that posts them.




af instalment debtors

Asset finance: the financed amount plus interest as it falls due, less receipts

	
	
	
	


lease debtors

Asset finance: rentals and end-of-term invoices once invoiced, less receipts

	
	
	
	


input vat

Asset finance: VAT on the dealer's invoice, on recovery costs and on repossession (s8(10))

	
	
	
	


leased assets

Cost excluding VAT of leased assets; depreciation stays in the fixed-asset register

	
	
	
	


asset disposal proceeds

Price excluding VAT of an asset sold to its lessee; derecognise its book value in the fixed-asset register

	
	
	
	


rental income

Lease rentals and end-of-term charges excluding VAT, as invoiced

	
	
	
	


maintenance income

Maintenance portion of full-maintenance lease rentals excluding VAT

	
	
	
	


maintenance fund liability

Lessee-settled maintenance funds: contributions less claims and refunds

	
	
	
	


maintenance expense

Maintenance claims paid on lender-risk leases

	
	
	
	


recovery clearing

Repossession sales and costs, per recovery; clears to nil once the proceeds are applied or the recovery is withdrawn

	
	
	
	


recovery costs payable

Supplier invoices for recovery costs, settled through accounts payable

	
	
	
	


recovery cost expense

Recovery costs charged to the borrower's account, excluding VAT

	
	
	
	


recovery costs recharged

Contra-expense: recovery costs charged to the borrower's account

	
	
	
	


recovery refund payable

Surplus owed back to the debtor after a recovery sale

	
	
	
	


recovery result

Gain or loss left in recovery clearing: output VAT less repossession and cost input VAT

	
	
	
	


af price credits

Price excluding VAT credited to an instalment-sale or finance-lease debtor on the inception invoice; book the dealer's matching credit, if any, against it
